description: This file defines the VacancyListViewController class within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It extends an abstract Vue controller and implements public controller interface, mainly setting up a Vue component and a template for the vacancy list view.

classes.name: VacancyListViewController
classes.description: Handles the setup of the vacancy list view by assigning a Vue component and specifying the template to use.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view before rendering by setting the Vue component to 'vacancy-list' and the template to 'no_header.html.twig'.
